mentions.name: audio-transcriber
mentions.description: A speech-to-text transcription program for Discord, similar to how Zoom or Google Hangouts works, that processes a set of 3-hour audio files in about 20 minutes. Built to record D&D group sessions and to enable applications and tools for virtual tabletop (VTT) gaming.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wanted to build my own speech-to-text transcription program [1] for Discord, similar to how zoom or google hangouts works. I built it so that I can record my group's DND sessions and build applications / tools for VTTs (Virtual TableTop gaming).
